image_title: Comparison of Max Utility Over Time
summary: This line chart illustrates the comparison of maximum utility achieved over time between two groups: LLM-based and template-based interfaces. The x-axis represents time in minutes, while the y-axis shows the maximum utility values, reaching up to 27. The chart features multiple lines representing different configurations of the LLM-based group, with shaded areas indicating standard deviation. Notably, the LLM-based approach consistently shows a gradual increase in utility over time, while the template-based approach also demonstrates a similar trend, albeit with different performance characteristics. The visualization highlights the comparative effectiveness of the two methodologies in achieving utility as time progresses.
